plan.notes: Official ASU major map (Media Arts and Sciences (Theatre), BA, plan HIDGCTBA, campus ASU00); term-by-term sequence as published; retrieved 2026-10-06. One map row = one seed slot. 'X or Y' alternatives transcribed as one choice slot (choice=true). Rows with large option pools transcribed as one choice slot naming the requirement. Gen-ed placeholders (no course link on the map) transcribed verbatim as choice slots. Map 'Term hours subtotal' rows are metadata, not courses (wave-33 convention). The official map lists the following slot(s) in more than one term; transcribed as shown with allow_repeated_courses per the genuine-repeat rule: AME 112: Computational Thinking for Digital Culture OR AME 130: Prototyping Dreams (L) OR AME 230: Programming for the Media Arts (CS); Digital Media Course OR Digital Culture Studies Course; ENG 101 OR ENG 102: First-Year Composition OR ENG 105: Advanced First-Year Composition OR ENG 107 OR ENG 108: First-Year Composition; Upper Division Digital Culture Studies Course; Upper Division Digital Media Course OR Upper Division Digital Culture Studies Course; Upper Division Theatre Design Course I; Upper Division Theatre Design Course II.
